name: Myopia Hunt Club
centre_source: OpenGolfAPI's OpenStreetMap link (42.6090024, -70.8583887); Wikipedia 42°36'32"N 70°51'32"W and Stymie's range point (42.609652, -70.857161) lie within 150 m. Probably near the clubhouse, not the course centroid; the box allows for that.
renovations: 1990s: superintendent Dave Heroian restored 25 bunkers, let the rough grow to fescue, removed trees (1998 article)
1995-2005: club lengthening (new tees on 2, 4, 7, 10, 11, 15, 18), trees removed, mounds added (Wikipedia)
2011 on: Gil Hanse, tree removal and fairway widening (Fried Egg, GOLF, GolfPass)
fuller Hanse restoration reported as pending by 2025 Golf Digest reviewers (unconfirmed)

holes 4 and 9 among Golf Magazine's top-100 signature holes
